business_problem: Three years ago, Kraken faced serious challenges due to rapid expansion across the world. As their volume of data skyrocketed, their siloed data infrastructure stood in the way of growth.
solution_summary: Kraken is an advanced operating platform for energy utilities, operating across 17 countries with more than 54 million customer accounts. As part of the Octopus Energy Group, Kraken helps utility businesses do everything from optimizing resources to delivering excellent customer experiences at a lower cost. Three years ago, Kraken faced serious challenges due to rapid expansion across the world. As their volume of data skyrocketed, their siloed data infrastructure stood in the way of growth. Kraken turned to Databricks and Delta Sharing for a flexible, open and secure solution that could support the evolution of their business and help create opportunities for innovation. Kraken’s platform integrates all parts of utility systems, offering energy customers a unified view of their business that enables a springboard for data-driven transformation. Previously, Kraken relied on a collection of various tools for data analysis.

solution_components.name: Delta Sharing
solution_components.role: Delivers governed data access across agencies, partners, or business units without copying datasets.

solution_components.name: Databricks SQL
solution_components.role: Serves dashboards, self-service queries, and business intelligence for downstream users.

solution_components.name: Delta Lake
solution_components.role: Stores curated lakehouse tables used for reliable downstream analytics and AI workloads.

data_flow: Operational, customer, and transactional data lands in Databricks, is transformed in Delta Lake tables, and is served to downstream users and applications through Databricks SQL, Delta Sharing.
business_outcome: Reported outcomes include 8x Reduction in data processing costs; 3 days to 8 hours.
architecture_clues: Uses Delta Sharing for governed data access across teams or partners.
